notes.title: DOWNLOAD THE OFFICIAL DEMO VERSION
notes.notes:
On March 20th 2014 around 9 AM PDT / 5 PM CET, the Official Demo version of [b]MXGP[/b] will be released on [b]STEAM[/b], with the following content. 

[b]Available tracks:[/b] Great Britain – Matterley Basin. 
[b]Riders:[/b] Antonio Cairoli, Clément Desalle and Gautier Paulin. 
[b]Quick Race:[/b] a double race, with no qualification and custom difficulty setting. Players can also have a sneak-peek at the menus and the tutorials. 
The release date of the home console version of the Demo will be announced later on.
